summary: Merged PR #15088 adds `thread.run(...)` and `async thread.run(...)` to the Python SDK, giving users a simpler path for common prompt-response flows without manually creating and running a turn handle.
title: Python SDK adds `thread.run()` convenience methods for one-shot turns
why_it_matters: This lowers the amount of SDK code needed for basic request-response usage. Python users can now send a string or input bundle directly from a thread and get a compact result object back, while the lower-level turn API remains available for streaming and more advanced control.
